name: 30135 · Douglasville, GA
findings: ZIP 30135 (Douglasville) has 245 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30135 (Douglasville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 34 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
